decisions.reason: As a newly launched Magento 2 shop template that fits the firm's web and e-commerce service profile, it is likely to be retained unless demand proves clearly too niche.
A responsive website template is close to the firm's core digital offering and should remain on the market because it can support both direct sales and agency work.
Premium customer support is a low-risk add-on service with good strategic fit and is therefore unlikely to be withdrawn so soon after launch.
A software version management tool suggests a more substantial proprietary offering, so management would usually give it more time before considering discontinuation.
An online tool for creating data processing contracts appears more opportunistic and narrower in scope, so management may reallocate resources if uptake after the GDPR-driven launch wave is limited.
